title: E - Waste Management and Recycling
sources_used: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

papers.paper_title: EXAMINATION PAPER 1: THIRD SEMESTER MGU-UGP(HONS.) REGULAR EXAM OCT 2025

questions.question: Evaluate pure metals and metal oxides
questions.solution_html:
• Precious metals: Au, Ag, Pt, Pd recovered from e-waste by
  • hydrometallurgy/electrometallurgy .
  • Metal oxides (Cu₂O, Fe₂O₃, ZnO, etc.) are obtained via electrodeposition or
  • oxidation.
  • Both forms serve as valuable raw materials for nanomaterials and
  • electronic components.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Illustrate the name of one biological method to enhance phytoremediation
questions.solution_html:
• Biological method to enhance phytoremediation
  • Use of mycorrhizal fungi and soil microorganisms improves metal uptake
  • and plant biomass .
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Differentiate electrotwinning and electrorefining
questions.solution_html:
• Electrowinning: extraction of metal from leach solution onto cathode.
  • Electrorefining: purification of impure metal anode; pure metal is deposited
  • on cathode .
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss about electrodeposition?
questions.solution_html:
• Electrochemical process depositing metal ions onto electrode surface.
  • Applied in recovery of Cu, Te, and rare earths; rate improved using ionic
  • liquids .
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Select the potential concern which is related to Phytovolatilization
questions.solution_html:
• Potential concern related to phytovolatilization
  • Volatilized contaminants (Hg, Se, As) may re-enter the environment via
  • precipitation; not fully removed .
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Classify types of contaminants into a table
questions.solution_html:
• Classify contaminants (table form)
  • Heavy metals Pb, Cd, Hg, Cu, Ni, Zn
  • Organic pollutants PCBs, PBDEs, PAHs
  • Gaseous/by-products Dioxins, furans
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Identify which type of contaminants can phytoremediation address
questions.solution_html:
• Contaminants phytoremediation can address
  • Trace metals (Pb, Cd, Cu, Ni, Zn, As, Hg, Se).
  • Organic compounds (PCBs, hydrocarbons) .
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Identify the process used to selectively precipitate metals from solution in hydrometallurgy
questions.solution_html:
• Process to selectively precipitate metals in hydrometallurgy
  • Chemical precipitation by pH control or double-salt formation after leaching
questions.final_answer: Process to selectively precipitate metals in hydrometallurgy
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Write the process involves in conversion of solid into soluble ions?
questions.solution_html:
• Process converting solid into soluble ions
  • Leaching: dissolution of metals using acids (H₂SO₄, HCl, HNO₃) .
questions.final_answer: Process converting solid into soluble ions
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Illustrate the type of nanomaterials used to improve phytoremediation efficiency
questions.solution_html:
• Nanomaterials used to improve phytoremediation
  • Metal/metal-oxide NPs (Fe₃O₄, ZnO, TiO₂, Ag) enhance uptake, enzyme
  • activity, and stress tolerance .
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Identify an innovative way to reduce E-waste
questions.solution_html:
• Innovative way to reduce e-waste
  • Circular economy: urban mining, eco-design, and biorecycling using
  • microorganisms .
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Predicate, how genetic engineering can improve phytoremediation efficiency
questions.solution_html:
• Transgenic plants with genes for metal transporters, chelators, or detox
  • enzymes show higher uptake .
  • Short Essay Type Questions
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Evaluate the main disadvantages and challenges of electrokinetic remediation.
questions.solution_html:
• Disadvantages and challenges of electrokinetic remediation
  • Slow process for low-conductivity soils.
  • Possible pH gradient, electrode corrosion, and high energy demand .
questions.final_answer: Possible pH gradient, electrode corrosion, and high energy demand
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Write oxidation and reduction reactions with suitable chemical equations.
questions.solution_html:
• Any correct answer - (5 marks)
  • example
  • Oxidation: Fe²⁺ → Fe³⁺ + e⁻
  • Reduction: Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu(s)
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Classify WEEE into five categories with examples
questions.solution_html:
• Classify WEEE into five categories
  • (i) Large household appliances
  • (ii) Small appliances
  • (iii) IT & telecom equipment
  • (iv) Consumer electronics
  • (v) Lighting, tools, toys, medical devices .
  • Give an example for each category
questions.final_answer: Give an example for each category
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Compare landfill and biological method
questions.solution_html:
• Compare landfill and biological method
  • Landfill → cheap, causes leachate pollution.
  • Biological (phytoremediation/bioremediation) → eco-friendly, slower .
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Identify the major limitations of rhizofiltration in terms of type or location of contaminants
questions.solution_html:
• Limitations of rhizofiltration
  • Effective only in water; requires constant maintenance; limited root depth .
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe five metals in printed circuit boards and their importance
questions.solution_html:
• Five metals in printed circuit boards and importance
  • Any correct answers - (5 marks)
  • Examples:Cu , Au , Ag (soldering), Pb
  • (solder), Ni (plating) .
  • Essay Type Questions
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain adsorption and desorption processes in detail. Describe their applications in e-waste management with examples.
questions.solution_html:
• Adsorption and desorption processes in e-waste
  • Adsorption: binds metal ions on surfaces (e.g., activated carbon, biochar).
  • Desorption :regenerates adsorbent.
  • Used for Cu, Pb, Ni recovery from leachates .
questions.final_answer: Used for Cu, Pb, Ni recovery from leachates
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Illustrate the way in which phytodegradation can be improved
questions.solution_html:
• Improving phytodegradation
  • Use of plants producing high enzyme levels (peroxidase, dehalogenase).
  • Combine with microbes, surfactants, or electric fields .
questions.final_answer: Combine with microbes, surfactants, or electric fields
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Evaluate the practical applications and limitations of electrokinetic remediation in large-scale organic waste treatment.
questions.solution_html:
• Applications and limitations of electrokinetic remediation
  • Removes metals and organics from soils.
  • Can be combined with PRB or phytoremediation .
  • Limitations: high cost, electrode degradation, uneven field distribution
questions.final_answer: Limitations: high cost, electrode degradation, uneven field distribution
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
